bull.point: Annualized AI revenue hit $3.1 billion, crossing 10% of total revenue.
TCV reached US$9.6 billion, up from $9.5 billion in Q1 FY27.
PAT grew 14.9% YoY, outpacing 11.2% revenue growth.
EBITDA margin expanded 0.6 pp YoY to 27.5%.

bear.point: Operating margin fell to 24%, missing the 26-28% target band.
Operating margin at 24% trails the 25% exit target.
North America and Continental Europe grew only 0.4% sequentially.
Debt/equity rose to 0.11 from 0.09 at FY22 end.
